description: Treat the root solver as a sealed interface whose only admissible behaviors are verified witness emission or explicit refusal. The practical aim is to stop legacy archive code from contaminating claims about the active artifact.
mathematical_formalization: For every input n, output \in Witness(n) \cup {ValueError}; no hidden transition into heuristic search states is permitted.
analogical_connections: ABI stability for a shared library
lab protocol quarantine between active samples and frozen archives
implementation_hypothesis: Audit imports and execution edges, then add regressions that enforce root-only imports and explicit unsupported behavior.
experiment_seed: Run the root test suite and a full n<=100 support sweep after any solver edit.

closest_prior_art.title: Lower bounds for book Ramsey numbers
String Graph Obstacles of High Girth and of Bounded Degree

novelty_claim: The novelty is not a new bound; it is the enforcement layer that keeps a partial witness packer from regressing back into heuristic or mixed-language behavior.
differentiation: Unlike the watchlist papers, this is a repo-control mechanism over a concrete submission artifact, not a new structural theorem about string or book graphs.
